items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: this was on a television show he did with Ralph Gleason

ctx.x: See all of these he writes the music and the words and everything himself and you hear him in his music which is to me the mark of a real musician. See?

I remember hearing him tell Duke that he had been playing, "Take the A Train" wrong. For a long, long time and he -- this was on a television show he did with Ralph Gleason he did for educational television, in San Francisco. And he played it the way, he said, "I wrote it, Edward," and he said "you haven't been playing it that way for a long time".

That's right, he was a very meticulous little fellow. And he was right in most everything he did. And many, many, many times Ellington would call him up from out on the road, "Sweetpea, I want an arrangement on so and so and so and so." Well, when do you need it? In a couple
